title: Grateful Dead Live at Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V. on 1993-05-16
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy show, highlighted by a smoking Cassidy jam, Wharf Rat, The Other One and inventive guitar work.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates the SBD source as flawless and praises the performance as a five‑star buildup with nonstop excitement. Set 2 is described as a cascade of standout moments—from the booming bass on Samson to the insane peak on Wharf Rat and an unforgettable Cassidy jam—while the guitars, especially Jerry’s late‑song licks, receive special commendation.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised as near‑perfect with many standout jams; recording is called the best‑sounding SBD source, giving a high combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it the “best sounding SBD source” and gives sound a perfect five‑star rating; no technical flaws mentioned.

standout_songs: Cassidy Jam (from Masterpiece → end of set)
Terrapin Station (3‑minute jam at the end)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 2 builds continuously with strong jams and tight transitions, culminating in high‑octane peaks; set 1 is described as a short but solid opener.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for an exceptional guitar part on Lovelight and intense shredding on Wharf Rat’s climax.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted for “twisting” moments—loud bursts on Samson, tumbling lines on Throwing Stones, and overall powerful presence in set 2.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for hard‑driven rhythm guitar interplay with Jerry during the Wharf Rat jam.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mention of drums being cut short at the end of the set, but otherwise no specific commentary.
